title: Grateful Dead Live at International Amphitheatre on 1973-02-19
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Feb 19 1973 second set featuring a monster jam from He's Gone through Truckin', The Other One, Eyes of the World and China Doll.
ai_review.review: The partial delivers an electrifying snapshot of one of the band’s peak February ’73 jams – a nonstop flow from He’s Gone into Truckin’, The Other One, a soaring Eyes of the World, the ethereal China Doll and a raucous finish with Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones.  Listeners repeatedly note the crystal‑clear soundboard mix that showcases Jerry’s flawless tone, Phil’s thunderous lead‑bass and tight drumming, making this a must‑have for any Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly high reviewer stars (average ~4.4) and consistent praise for both the performance and the clean soundboard recording drive a strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with no noticeable drop‑outs; captures full band dynamics despite the venue’s poor acoustics. Reviewers highlight the clarity of guitar, bass and drums.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, almost 70‑minute second‑set jam that flows from He's Gone into Truckin', then The Other One, followed by an expansive Eyes of the World and a beautiful China Doll before closing with high‑octane Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for perfect tone on China Doll and overall guitar/vocal emotion; described as flawless throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted – ‘Lesh kicks ass’, lead‑bass from start to finish, peak February ’73 performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's cymbals noted for shimmering crash and tight, driving rhythm supporting the jams.
